stem: Read the case. If DNA had replicated conservatively (both parental strands staying together and the new molecule being made entirely of new strands), what would the CsCl gradient have shown after the first generation in 14N medium?

One heavy band and one light band
A single band of light density
One heavy band and one hybrid band
